description: This file defines the JobSpecificationAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for retrieving job specification data associated with job titles within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching a specific job specification by ID and handles validation rules for API requests. The class interacts with the JobTitleService to obtain data and constructs response objects adhering to the API's response schema.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing job specifications related to job titles, providing functionality for fetching specific job specification data and validation rules within the OrangeHRM system.
